description: Source file implementing F1-C interface for UE context bearer management, including handling of SDUs, PDUs, and delivery/transmission notifications within the F1AP protocol stack.

classes.name: f1c_srb0_du_bearer
classes.description: Handles F1AP communication for SRB0, including initial message transfer and SDU handling.

classes.name: f1c_other_srb_du_bearer
classes.description: Manages F1AP communication for other SRBs, including PDU processing, delivery, and transmission notifications.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Processes incoming SDUs, wraps them into F1AP messages, and notifies upper layers.

methods.name: handle_transmit_notification
methods.description: Handles transmission notifications; not applicable for SRB0.

methods.name: handle_delivery_notification
methods.description: Handles delivery notifications; not applicable for SRB0.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Forwards PDU to lower layers after switching to UE execution context.

methods.name: handle_pdu_and_await_delivery
methods.description: Handles PDU and waits for delivery confirmation or timeout for SRB0.

methods.name: handle_pdu_and_await_transmission
methods.description: Handles PDU and waits for transmission confirmation for SRB0.

methods.name: handle_pdu_and_await
methods.description: Generic method for handling PDU and awaiting either transmission or delivery.

methods.name: handle_notification
methods.description: Updates internal state and triggers events upon PDCP SN notifications.

methods.name: wait_for_notification
methods.description: Returns an awaitable that completes when the specified PDCP SN is delivered or transmitted, or times out.

methods.name: handle_rrc_delivery_report
methods.description: Constructs and sends an RRC delivery report message to the gNB-CU.
